name: Stripe
flow: create account to first payment link

steps.title: Stripe | Financial Infrastructure to Grow Your Revenue
Sign up and create a Stripe account | Stripe
steps.note: Stopped: account form or bot check reached.

jtbd_fit.evidence: Hero lists the jobs: "Accept payments, handle business banking, and implement custom revenue models".

capability_visible.evidence: Step 2 shows a real-looking dashboard (Balances, Transactions, Customers) behind the signup modal.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Pricing is only a nav link in the captured steps.

time_to_value.evidence: Flow stopped at the account form.

friction.evidence: Account form has four fields (email, name, password, country) plus Google sign-up.

trust.evidence: Named logo wall: OpenAI, Amazon, Nvidia, Ford, Coinbase, Google, Shopify.

mobile.evidence: Mobile capture exists for step 1 but was not assessed.

states.evidence: No error or empty states reached.

value_prop_clarity.evidence: Clear to a developer or finance lead. "Financial infrastructure" and "custom revenue models" are harder for a small merchant.

proof_quality.evidence: Logos are specific, but "Global GDP running on Stripe: 1.75356688%" has no visible source.

persuasion_integrity.evidence: No urgency or scarcity. The banner announces news instead of pushing a deal.

cta_logic.evidence: "Get started" is primary, Google sign-up secondary, "Contact sales" separated top-right.

read.summary: A clear, credible start for builders and finance teams. The signup modal over a live-looking dashboard is the strongest move in the flow.
pros: Signup appears over the product dashboard, so the visitor sees where they are going.
Logo wall uses specific, recognisable brands.
Primary and secondary CTAs are clearly ranked.
cons: Copy skews toward technical and enterprise readers; a first-time small merchant may not see themselves.
The GDP counter is an unsourced, attention-grabbing claim.
Four required fields before seeing anything inside the product.
read.howItSells: Sells scale and credibility ("first transaction to your billionth") through named customers and an ambitious stat. Positions Stripe as infrastructure rather than a store tool.
copy: Show the product behind the signup modal.
Rank CTAs: self-serve primary, sales secondary.

hypothesis.statement: A segment-specific headline for small merchants ("Take your first payment today") will improve signup rate among non-developer visitors.
hypothesis.metric: Signup start to account-created rate for small-merchant traffic
hypothesis.decisionRule: Ship to the small-merchant segment if completion rises by a pre-agreed margin and developer rate holds.

claims.text: From your first transaction to your billionth
